title: Narra 4.1.32 — offline anime and TV focus
message: Install 4.1.32 over Narra 4.1.31 to keep your library and downloads. Asian Drama is available in Discover for everyone, offline anime downloads are more reliable, and TV focus is easier to see.
changelog: Update over 4.1.31 without uninstalling to keep your local library, downloads, and settings.
Asian Drama is available to free users in Discover; Arabic Anime remains on Home but is hidden from Discover.
Offline anime downloads better handle encrypted and image-padded streams and reject unusable video files. Redownload any older episode that will not play.
Downloaded anime episodes appear individually in the Download Hub.
TV remote focus outlines are easier to see.
